scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/cli && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/desktop
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@repolens/shared && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/core && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/language-support && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/database && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/export && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/ai
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@repolens/desktop
